model_caveats: Minutes and attacking allocation use the Phase 4b/5 champion models (exponential_decay, calibrated; shrinkage_share), fed by 6 settled gameweek(s) of history reconstructed from this pipeline's own raw snapshots (apex_fpl.serving.gameweek_history) -- not the historical Vaastav archive.

The GW7 switchover point matches Phase 4b's own tournament evidence boundary, not an independently re-validated optimal transition for this specific cold-start handoff -- a dedicated replay study of the exact best switchover point has not been done.

Reconstructed history can have real gaps (a pipeline outage skips the affected gameweek(s) rather than guessing) -- individual players with little or no reconstructed history fall back to each model's own uninformative-prior behavior, not a crash.

Team model's historical fallback uses 2024-25 (the archive's most recent season) -- 2025/26 is not yet in this project's historical archive, so this prior is staler than the mechanism was designed for.
